en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a European historic town with steep tiled roofs and narrow streets. In the foreground stands a large gabled building with several stepped Renaissance-style façades facing a small square. In the background on a hill rises a vast castle-like complex with long wings, towers, and a prominent Gothic cathedral with twin spires and another tall tower, dominating the skyline and surrounding town.
